stages.question: Are supplied artifacts and numerical identities reproducible locally?
stages.action: validate_v3.sh; optional local N32/N64 CUDA checks
stages.gate: All tests pass, original hashes unchanged, independent NumPy RHS agrees, expected RK orders, CPU/GPU comparisons in tolerance

stages.question: Does the same implementation work on the target H100 runtime?
stages.action: launch_h100_smoke.py plan; execute only after actual approval
stages.resource: One already provisioned H100; N128 then N256; t=0.05; two ICs and schemes
stages.gate: All tests pass; scalar scheme relative errors <=5e-4; Parseval relative error <=2e-6; divergence <=1e-4; tail <=1e-6; finite diagnostics; no watchdog failures

stages.question: Does the nu=2.5e-4 tube peak converge in grid and time?
stages.action: Recover missing N768 data if possible; otherwise run same-source N512/N768 and halve dt independently at each grid, sample identical times
stages.resource: H100; historical N512 ~122 seconds; N768 log ~0.717 seconds per step, full duration unverified
stages.gate: Predeclare peak-window [0,1]; timestep effect <0.5% and grid difference <2% for E,Z,wmax as a screening target; tails <=1e-6; investigate failures, do not fit
stages.status: requires approval and H100 smoke pass

stages.question: Is N1024 memory headroom credible for the exact configuration?
stages.action: N768 LSRK4 at least 5 steps with every requested output exercised; retain v3 manifest
stages.resource: H100; current v3 memory unknown; old SSPRK3 peak was 33.8 GB
stages.gate: Same source, GPU model, runtime, scheme, precision, IC and diagnostic configuration; scaled maximum allocated/reserved peak <=80% of current total AND free memory

stages.question: Does a justified high-resolution run reduce the remaining grid error?
stages.action: N1024 only after stage 2/3 evidence and explicit separate go decision
stages.resource: H100; historical original N1024 took ~2261 seconds and ~80.09 GB allocated; this is NOT a v3 memory reference
stages.gate: Budget confirmed, v3 memory preflight passes, short smoke then matched-time comparison; no weakening of memory threshold

stages.question: Is a physical viscosity-scaling fit justified?
stages.action: Only consider after >=3 distinct viscosities pass independent grid/time convergence and matched sampling checks
stages.gate: Report fit uncertainty and window sensitivity; never infer regularity or reconnection from finite sampled maxima
